scope: User-observed L0 physical webcam prototype trials. One participant, uncontrolled conditions; not a PAD accuracy estimate, identity authentication, or official MOSIP-client test.
limitations: One rejection followed by two accepted trials; repeated user resets occurred.
Some sessions restarted active sequences before reaching a terminal outcome.
The score history keys were filtered by the audit sanitizer in this version, so no complete score trace can be reconstructed.
No physical print or screen-replay attack was tested.
